summary: Built redundant dual-uplink connectivity between node1 and node2 (each bonding its two parallel eth1/eth2 links into a balance-rr bond0 over a 172.20.0.0/31 transit), with node1/node2 each routing to their private-network hosts (node3 on 192.168.10.0/24, node4 on 192.168.20.0/24) via their eth3 interfaces. Verified node3<->node4 reachability persists with 0% loss when either individual link is fully failed (both ends down) and traffic uses both links simultaneously in steady state. Configuration was made persistent (systemd oneshot service on node1/node2, systemd-networkd .network file on node3/node4) and confirmed to survive a full reboot. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart recovery verification.
actions_performed: Inspected all four nodes' interfaces and routes to map topology
Ran mandatory SONiC pre-config cleanup (docker0 class-E strip, stopped interfaces-config.service) on node1/node2
Empirically identified physical link pairing via ping tests: node1 eth1<->node2 eth1, node1 eth2<->node2 eth2, node1 eth3<->node3 enp8s0, node2 eth3<->node4 enp8s0
Attempted 802.3ad LACP bonding; discovered virtio NICs fail ethtool speed/duplex reporting, breaking LACP negotiation (dmesg 'failed to get link speed/duplex', Partner Mac 00:00:00:00:00:00)
Rebuilt bond0 on node1/node2 in balance-rr mode (miimon 100), which needs no LACP negotiation and uses both links simultaneously with instant failover
Assigned 172.20.0.0/31 and 172.20.0.1/31 to bond0 on node1/node2; assigned 192.168.10.1/24 and 192.168.20.1/24 to eth3; enabled ip_forward and per-interface forwarding; added cross static routes
Assigned 192.168.10.2/24 to node3 and 192.168.20.2/24 to node4 with static routes to the other private network
Verified end-to-end node3<->node4 connectivity and confirmed both bond0 slave interfaces carry traffic (tx/rx counters incrementing on both eth1 and eth2)
Tested full link failure for link1 (eth1 down both ends) and link2 (eth2 down both ends) sequentially, confirming 0% packet loss failover in both cases, then restored both links
Persisted node1/node2 config via a new systemd oneshot service (antrieb-uplinks.service) that rebuilds bond0/eth3/routes at boot, masking interfaces-config.service to prevent clobbering
Persisted node3/node4 config via systemd-networkd .network file (10-enp8s0-private.network) taking precedence over the default DHCP-matching file
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, uptime, bond/route state, live ping) on all four nodes

Restarted node3, node4, node1, node2 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified bond/route state, antrieb-uplinks.service activity, and node3<->node4 connectivity after each restart

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline before any restart (all 4 nodes)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, uptime, bond0 slave MII status, and live cross-network ping on all four nodes prior to any restart

evidence.requirement: Redundant dual-link topology identified and confirmed
evidence.summary: Ping tests confirmed node1 eth1<->node2 eth1, node1 eth2<->node2 eth2 as the two independent links, and node1 eth3<->node3, node2 eth3<->node4 as the private-network legs

evidence.requirement: Both links carry traffic simultaneously (not just active/passive)
evidence.summary: eth1 and eth2 tx/rx counters on node1 incremented roughly evenly across ping traffic, confirming balance-rr round-robin usage of both links

evidence.requirement: node3<->node4 reachability survives loss of either individual link
evidence.summary: With link1 (eth1) fully down on both node1 and node2, node3->node4 ping showed 0% loss; link1 restored, link2 (eth2) downed on both ends, node4->node3 ping showed 0% loss; both links then restored and reverified with a 0% loss traffic-both-links check

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged via detached setsid systemctl reboot; boot_id changed from 5f292bc7... to 685633de...; antrieb-uplinks.service active, bond0/eth3 routes restored, node3->node4 ping 0% loss post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from ce04f497... to 7f05e4d4...; antrieb-uplinks.service active, bond0/eth3 routes restored, node3->node4 steady-state ping 0% loss post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from dfeb3b70... to dda94a01...; enp8s0 static IP/route persisted via systemd-networkd, ping to node4 0% loss post-restart

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 01c87a03... to d1d93ed1...; enp8s0 static IP/route persisted via systemd-networkd, ping to node3 0% loss post-restart
